quests.title: Glass Venom
quests.text: Glass-Fang Serpents coil in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways} {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways} by day. Bring three Glass Venom; our healers thin it into a cure for the very bite it comes from. The canopy teaches patience, and so do serpents.

quests.title: Webs in the Rootways
quests.text: At night Glass-Web Jungle Spiders spin across the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways}, and nothing that walks there by day is safe. Kill six of them after dark. The roots will breathe again.
quests.lesson: The same kind at night; one outing serves both.

quests.title: Apes of the High Canopy
quests.text: Glass-Knuckle Jungle Apes rule the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy} {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy} by day and throw whatever they find at whoever they see. Defeat six of them. Do not take it personally; they throw at each other too.
quests.lesson: The top belt of Skyglass by day.

quests.title: The Paymaster
quests.text: {name:paymaster_chirr} pays the Last-Pay Archers at the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp} {dir_from_giver:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp}, in coin taken from the dead of both banners. Defeat five of his archers and then Chirr himself. The canopy keeps no ledger of debts, and neither shall he.
quests.lesson: Front climax: the last named normal leader before 60.

quests.title: Group: Serpent Glass-Throat
quests.text: {name:glass_throat_serpent} coils in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy} {dir_from_giver:glass_throat_serpent}, an elite serpent older than our oldest tree. Gather a group before you go. Some things in the canopy are best met in company.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite; the route reaches 60 without it.

quests.title: Bounty: High Canopy Panthers
quests.text: Glass-Shadow Panthers stalk the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy} after dark. Bring down five of them at night, and I will reward you each time. The next bounty opens twenty-five minutes after you hand this one in.
quests.lesson: Repeatable hunting bounty, upper Skyglass by night.
